evidenceClasses.summary: An eligible allied recipient is accepted and receives only the canonical allied effects.
A reviewed alternate rules-text branch selects and resolves its distinct outcome.
One area resolution contains both affected and unaffected or hit and missed recipients with per-target results.
An authorized participant selects a legal durable option and the selected branch resolves once.
A critical hit follows the move's reviewed critical-hit policy and modifier ordering.
An eligible enemy recipient is accepted while non-enemy recipients are excluded.
A successful accuracy or automatic-hit branch applies the canonical effects.
A relevant immunity prevents only the effects it canonically blocks and records the reason.
Expiry, switch, knockout, cancellation, or scene cleanup removes the effect exactly once at the canonical boundary.
The effect triggers exactly once at its canonical authoritative lifecycle boundary.
A failed accuracy branch applies no hit-only effect or mutation while retaining canonical declaration costs.
A stale consulted or written resource rejects the whole resolution without a partial mutation.
An authorized participant passes or declines and the canonical no-selection branch resolves once.
Refresh or reconnect restores the same authoritative pending state and permits one continuation.
Duplicate or uncertain delivery returns the original result without rerolling, spending, or applying effects again.
The actor is resolved as the canonical self recipient without accepting an unrelated target.
A threshold or conditional predicate fails and omits the guarded effect.
A threshold or conditional predicate passes and applies the guarded effect.

requirements.summary: Apply when the move has a hit and miss branch, including server-owned accuracy checks.
Apply once for each reviewed family of mutually distinct canonical rules-text branches.
Apply when the move can critically hit or overrides normal critical-hit behavior.
Apply when type, condition, effect, field, item, or other canonical immunity is consulted.
Apply when a roll threshold, state predicate, or conditional clause gates an effect.
Apply when a participant chooses among durable options or may decline the offered effect.
Apply to ordinary damaging resolution; mark canonically impossible branches not applicable with a reviewed reason.
Apply to delayed, duration-based, charged, triggered, or source-linked encounter effects.
Apply when resolution opens a durable choice, reaction, interruption, or other resumable state.
Apply when the move mutates state, spends a resource, rolls, or opens a pending resolution.
Apply when one resolution consults or writes more than one authoritative map, sheet, inventory, or pending resource.
Apply when at least one branch requires or affects allies.
Apply when geometry can include multiple recipients with independent eligibility or accuracy outcomes.
Apply when at least one branch requires or affects enemies.
Apply when at least one branch targets or directly affects the actor.
